integrity.description: Verify the agent didn't just echo the expected word counts into a file without running Docker.
integrity.visual_evidence: Check terminal history for 'docker run' commands and ensure the Python script actually performs file I/O and calculations.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't run the containers sequentially.
integrity.visual_evidence: Look for the use of '&', 'xargs -P', or 'parallel' in the shell script, rather than a simple for-loop that waits for each container to finish.

integrity.description: Verify the 'book-analyzer:latest' image was actually built and used.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'docker images' listing the specific tag or 'docker run' referencing that exact image name.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The final report should show word counts approximately near these values: Pride and Prejudice (~130,415), Moby Dick (~215,845), Sherlock Holmes (~107,558), Frankenstein (~78,106), and Alice in Wonderland (~29,569).
